source_of_truth: Markdown is canonical authored knowledge; generated memory indexes are instance-local and must remain rebuildable.
raw_material_policy: 01_sources/raw text, JSON, transcripts, PDFs and small supporting images are part of the portable Git snapshot. Heavy audio/video media are local-only until a Git LFS/archive policy is selected. Raw material is not treated as curated source of truth until summarized into notes, signals, briefs or assessments.
